what: research/archive/INTEGRATION.md section 8: product-level dead air / cut-ins of the shipped rules (hybrid_dyn, hybrid_silero, --enroll after_agent_arm) vs the 1000 ms timeout on the 5 AMI windows of section 4, Pipecat then LiveKit
code_commit: 4e90fd5 (servers and demos run from a clean git worktree of this commit)
server: python -m audioforge.serve --asr runs/stage1_served.afm --diar runs/nemo_sortformer_v2.afm --turn-input diar --threads 2 --debug-fields --enroll dominant|after_agent_arm (default --diar-config low_latency_032); CPU; one server per plan (<= 2 policy lines), load gate 1-min load < 8 at start (hard stop >= 10)

policies.timeout: 1000 ms plain timeout on the label-free primary (control)
policies.hybrid_dyn: head p >= 0.998283 OR Silero any-speaker silence - clamp(75 - 55 p, 2, 75) > 4.957 frames
policies.hybrid_silero: head p >= 0.99828 OR Silero any-speaker silence >= 2640 ms
policies.after_agent_arm: server --enroll after_agent_arm; agent_end injected at the previous other speaker's turn end from the labels (enrollment.agent_end_frame), a stand-in for a TTS-end event; 0.0 s where the window has no earlier other-speaker turn (ES2011b_027, IS1008b_014)

pads.why: the dyn wait reaches 6.4 s at p = 0; the same pad for all six policies

injection.pipecat: WavInputTransport pushes a BotStoppedSpeakingFrame after the 20 ms frame reaching agent_end_s; AudioforgeSTTService(enroll='after_agent_arm') sends agent_end; the frame is dropped after the STT
injection.livekit: AudioforgeFrontend.agent_end() once all frames before agent_end_s were pushed (stream mode and AgentSession mode)

definitions: as research/archive/INTEGRATION.md section 4: decision = turn_end.t - true end; dead air = arrival at the client - true end (Pipecat: UserStoppedSpeakingFrame; LiveKit: STT END_OF_SPEECH; commit = AgentSession(turn_detection='stt') user-turn commit); cut-in = a decision while the primary speaks again within 1 s
sanity_notes: all 30 Pipecat runs: EndFrame, 0 violations, 0 warnings, 0 pipeline errors

LiveKit: 1 server session per run, every END_OF_SPEECH after a FINAL; IS1008b_014 under the four hybrid runs has one more END_OF_SPEECH than cutting turn_ends: the end-of-stream flush final at 27.0 s (another speaker talks after the decision), as in section 4b
LiveKit AgentSession-mode server backlog_ms_max 1800-2000 = LiveKit pushing 2 s of silence into the STT on close (known quirk, section 5)
no session had RTF > 1; the Pipecat hybrid_dyn IS1008b_014 run had RTF 0.99 and a 1.74 s backlog: its dead air (3682) is load-inflated (decision 2240, same as its rerun under arm: 2563)
